malay2.title: യുദ്ധപങ്കാളി രാഷ്ട്രങ്ങളെത്തുന്ന ബ്രിക്സ്; ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ഭാഗത്തുനിന്ന് നയതന്ത്ര നീക്കമുണ്ടാകുമോ?
malay2.description: ന്യൂഡൽഹി ∙ രണ്ടു യുദ്ധങ്ങൾക്കിടെ നടക്കുന്നത് എന്നതിനെക്കാൾ 2 യുദ്ധങ്ങളിലെയും ഓരോ പങ്കാളിരാഷ്ട്രങ്ങളുടെ തലവന്മാർ പങ്കെടുക്കുന്നത് എന്ന നിലയിലാകും ഇന്നാരംഭിക്കുന്ന ബ്രിക്സ് ദ്വിദിന ഉച്ചകോടിയെ ചരിത്രം ഓർക്കുക. യുക്രെയ്ൻ യുദ്ധത്തിൽ പങ്കാളിയായ റഷ്യയുടെയും ഗൾഫ് മേഖലയിൽ യുഎസിനെതിരെ ആയുധമെടുത്തിരിക്കുന്ന ഇറ

malay2.title: ശബരിമല: അവലോകന യോഗം ചേർന്നു; വീഴ്ച പാടില്ലെന്ന് മുഖ്യമന്ത്രി
malay2.description: തിരുവനന്തപുരം ∙ ശബരിമല തീർഥാടനം ആരംഭിച്ച ശേഷവും മുന്നൊരുക്ക പ്രവൃത്തികൾ തുടരുന്ന സാഹചര്യം ഇത്തവണ ഉണ്ടാകരുതെന്ന് മുഖ്യമന്ത്രി വി.ഡി.സതീശൻ. സൗകര്യങ്ങളും സുരക്ഷയും ഒരുക്കുന്നതിൽ വീഴ്ച പാടില്ലെന്നു മണ്ഡല, മകരവിളക്ക് തീർഥാടന അവലോകന യോഗത്തിൽ മുഖ്യമന്ത്രി നിർദേശിച്ചു.

malay2.title: മാലിന്യസംസ്കരണ ശേഖരണരീതി മാറുന്നു: ഇനി കാശ് കിട്ടും; വീടിന്റെ വലുപ്പമനുസരിച്ച് യൂസർഫീ
malay2.description: തിരുവനന്തപുരം ∙ സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് വീടുകളിൽനിന്നുള്ള അജൈവമാലിന്യം ശേഖരിക്കുന്ന രീതിയിൽ സമഗ്രമാറ്റം വരുന്നു. സംസ്കരിച്ച് ഉപയോഗിക്കാവുന്നവയ്ക്കു പ്രതിഫലം നൽകാനാണ് ആലോചിക്കുന്നത്. വീട്ടുകാരെ മാലിന്യങ്ങൾ തരംതിരിക്കാൻ പ്രേരിപ്പിക്കാനും സംസ്കരണം സാധ്യമല്ലാത്ത ഒറ്റത്തവണ മാത്രം ഉപയോഗമുള്ള പ്ലാസ്റ്റിക് ഉൾപ്പെടെയുള്

malay2.title: ഓട്ടോ ഡ്രൈവറുടെ മൃതദേഹം റോഡിൽ കത്തിക്കരിഞ്ഞ നിലയിൽ
malay2.description: ആലപ്പുഴ∙ ഓട്ടോ ഡ്രൈവറുടെ മൃതദേഹം റോഡിന് മധ്യത്തിലായി കത്തിക്കരിഞ്ഞ നിലയിൽ കണ്ടെത്തി. കഞ്ഞിക്കുഴി പുത്തനമ്പലം സ്റ്റാൻഡിലെ ഓട്ടോ ഡ്രൈവർ രേവതി നിവാസിൽ രമേശൻ (65) ആണ് മരിച്ചത്.

malay2.title: ബ്രിക്സ് ഉച്ചകോടി: സംയുക്ത പ്രസ്താവനയിൽ ആശയക്കുഴപ്പം; അഭിപ്രായഐക്യം അകലെ?
malay2.description: ന്യൂഡൽഹി ∙ ബ്രിക്സ് ഉച്ചകോടി ഇന്ന് ആരംഭിക്കാനിരിക്കെ സംയുക്തപ്രസ്താവനയിൽ അഭിപ്രായഐക്യത്തിലെത്താൻ സാധിച്ചിട്ടില്ലെന്നു സൂചന. പശ്ചിമേഷ്യയുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട വിഷയത്തിലാണു തർക്കവും ആശയക്കുഴപ്പവും തുടരുന്നത്. ബ്രിക്സ് ഷെർപ്പ തലത്തിലെ ചർച്ചകളിലൂടെ ഐക്യമുണ്ടാക്കാൻ സാധിക്കുമെന്ന പ്രതീക്ഷയിലാണു വിദേശകാര്യ മന്ത

malay2.title: സൗദിയിലെ പ്രധാന എണ്ണ പൈപ്പ് ലൈനിൽ ആക്രമണം; തന്ത്രപ്രധാനമായ പെരിം ദ്വീപ് ഹൂതികൾ പിടിച്ചു
malay2.description: ദുബായ്∙ ഇറാഖിൽ നിന്നുള്ള ഡ്രോൺ ആക്രമണങ്ങളുടെ പശ്ചാത്തലത്തിൽ സൗദി അറേബ്യ ഈസ്റ്റ്-വെസ്റ്റ് ഓയിൽ പൈപ്പ്‌ലൈനിന്റെ പ്രവർത്തനം താൽക്കാലികമായി നിർത്തി. ഇറാന്റെ പിന്തുണയുള്ള സായുധ ഗ്രൂപ്പുകളാണ് ആക്രമണത്തിന് പിന്നിലെന്നാണ് സൂചന. സംഭവത്തെ തുടർന്ന് ഇറാൻ–ഇറാഖ് അതിർത്തി അടച്ചു. മുസ്‌ലിം വേൾഡ് ലീഗ് ആക്രമണത്തെ അപല

malay2.title: ഭക്തർ ക്ഷേത്രങ്ങളിൽ കയറുമ്പോൾ ഫോൺ മോഷ്ടിക്കും; സിസിടിവി തെളിവായി, മുൻ പൊലീസുകാരൻ അറസ്റ്റിൽ
malay2.description: തളിപ്പറമ്പ് ∙ ക്ഷേത്രത്തിൽ തൊഴാൻ കയറുന്നവർ പുറത്തുവച്ച മൊബൈൽ ഫോണുകൾ മോഷ്ടിച്ച സംഭവത്തിൽ, സേനയിൽനിന്ന് പുറത്താക്കപ്പെട്ട പൊലീസുകാരൻ അറസ്റ്റിൽ. പയ്യന്നൂർ അന്നൂർ പുതിയങ്കാവ് വെള്ളോറ മഠത്തിൽ വിപിൻകുമാറിനെയാണ് (39) അറസ്റ്റ് ചെയ്തത്. നേരത്തേ മോഷണക്കേസുകളിലടക്കം ഉൾപ്പെട്ടതിനാൽ ഇയാളെ സേനയിൽനിന്ന്

malay2.title: കത്തിക്കയറാൻ വരട്ടെ!; പിണറായി സർക്കാരുകളുടെ 10 വർഷത്തിനിടെ 20 തവണ വൈദ്യുതി നിയന്ത്രണം
malay2.description: തിരുവനന്തപുരം ∙ ‘കഴിഞ്ഞ 10 വർഷത്തിനിടയിൽ ജനിച്ച കുട്ടികൾ ആദ്യമായാണ് കറന്റ് പോകുന്നതു കാണുന്നത്, ഇരുട്ടത്ത് മെഴുകുതിരി കത്തിച്ചുവച്ചു പഠിക്കുന്നത്...’ ഈ മാസം തുടർച്ചയായ ദിവസങ്ങളിൽ 2–3 തവണ വരെ വൈദ്യുതി നിയന്ത്രണം ഏർപ്പെടുത്തിയപ്പോൾ ഇടതുപക്ഷത്തിന്റെ സൈബർ പ്രചാരണം ഇങ്ങനെ കത്തിക്കയറുകയാണ്.

malay2.title: കലിഫോർണിയ ഇരട്ടക്കൊലപാതകം: ക്യാമറയിലെ ദൃശ്യങ്ങൾ ആരോ നശിപ്പിച്ചു, ചെരുപ്പുകൾ അനിലയുടേത്, കൈകളിൽ രക്തം
malay2.description: കോട്ടയം ∙ യുഎസിലെ കലിഫോർണിയയിൽ ഇരട്ടക്കൊലപാതകക്കേസിൽ അറസ്റ്റിലായ മൂന്നിലവ് തഴയ്ക്കവയൽ മാറാമറ്റം അനില ബേബിക്ക് (32) എതിരെ കൂടുതൽ തെളിവുകളും മെഡിക്കൽ റിപ്പോർട്ടുകളും കോടതിയിൽ പൊലീസ് ഹാജരാക്കി. രക്തം, ഡിഎൻഎ എന്നിവ പരിശോധിച്ചതിന്റെയും സാഹചര്യത്തെളിവുകളുടെയും അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിൽ 2 കൊലപാതകങ്ങളുമായും അനിലയ്ക്കു

japan1.title: オープンAI 開発一時中断 AIみずからサイバー攻撃実行のおそれ
japan1.description: 生成AIの「ChatGPT」の開発を手がけるアメリカのオープンAIは、AIモデル「アストラ」の開発の一時中断を7日、発表しました。理由について、AIの能力が大幅に向上し、みずからの判断で重大なサイバー攻撃を実行するおそれが排除できないとしています。

japan1.title: 「なりすまし広告」詐欺対策強化を 政府がSNS事業者に要請
japan1.description: SNS上で有名人の写真などを無断で使った「なりすまし広告」による詐欺の被害が相次ぐなか、政府は、SNSの運営事業者に対して、広告主の本人確認といった対策を強化するよう文書で要請しました。

japan1.title: 千葉 銚子 輸入サバ高騰で加工業者の約2割が倒産や廃業状態に
japan1.description: サバの加工が盛んな千葉県銚子市では、原料の大半を占めるノルウェー産などの輸入サバの価格高騰で水産加工業者の採算が悪化し、およそ2割が倒産や、事実上の廃業状態にあることが分かりました。

japan1.title: KDDI 楽天への回線提供の契約 9月で終了 一部では提供継続
japan1.description: KDDIが楽天モバイルに回線を貸し出す「ローミング契約」について、KDDIの松田浩路社長は、決算会見で、現在の契約は9月末で終了するものの、過疎地などエリアを限定して通信回線の提供を続ける考えを明らかにしました。

japan1.title: 米就業者 市場予想に反し減少 利上げ観測後退で円高ドル安進む
japan1.description: 円相場や株価に影響を及ぼすアメリカの雇用統計が発表され、7月の農業分野以外の就業者は減少に転じ、市場の予想を大幅に下回りました。アメリカのFRB＝連邦準備制度理事会が早期に利上げに踏み切るという観測がいくぶん後退し、外国為替市場では、公表後にドルを売って円を買う動きが進みました。

japan1.title: 石油元売りに新交付金案 原油の代替調達促す 経産省会合で
japan1.description: 原油の調達先を多角化するため、石油元売り会社がホルムズ海峡をはじめリスクの高いルートを避けて調達する場合、会社に対して交付金を支給するという案が7日に開かれた経済産業省の会合で新たに示されました。

japan1.title: 東芝 最終利益4兆4000億円余 キオクシアHD株の評価益などで
japan1.description: 株式を非上場化して経営の立て直しを進めている東芝は、ことし4月から6月までの決算を発表し、株式を保有する半導体大手、キオクシアホールディングスの評価益などの影響で、最終的な利益が前の年の同じ時期のおよそ30倍となる4兆4000億円余りとなりました。

japan1.title: NY外国為替市場 円高ドル安が進む 米雇用統計発表受け
japan1.description: 7日のニューヨーク外国為替市場では、アメリカの雇用統計の発表を受けて、労働市場が減速しているという受け止めからドルを売って円を買う動きが強まりました。発表前、円相場は1ドル＝158円台前半で推移していましたが、一時、1ドル＝156円台後半まで1円以上、円高ドル安が進みました。

japan1.title: 食料自給率37％ 過去最低に コメの価格高騰が低下招く
japan1.description: 昨年度のカロリーベースの食料自給率は、前の年度より1ポイント下がって37％と過去最低になりました。価格高騰でコメの消費が減ったことが大きく響きました。

japan1.title: 食料品の消費税減税 ねらいは カギを握る片山財務相に聞く
japan1.description: 暮らしに関わる食料品の消費税減税。カギを握る片山財務大臣が閣議決定後、NHKのインタビューに応じました。財源は確保できるのか。足元の財務省内に反対論はないのか。ニュースウオッチ9の広内キャスターが直撃しました。

japan1.title: ビール大手3社 中間決算 各社売り上げ増 国内のビール販売好調
japan1.description: 大手ビールメーカー3社のことし上半期の決算は、国内のビール販売が好調だったことなどから、いずれも売り上げが伸び、このうち2社では、この時期として過去最高となりました。

japan1.title: 円相場 値下がり 米雇用統計発表控え様子見の投資家も
japan1.description: 7日の東京外国為替市場、円相場はドルに対して値下がりしました。

japan1.title: シャープ イラン情勢と円安で業績予想を下方修正
japan1.description: 大手電機メーカーの「シャープ」は、イラン情勢や円安の影響による原材料や燃料価格の高騰で、今年度の業績予想を下方修正し、最終的な利益が、当初の予想から40％余り減少するとの見通しを明らかにしました。

japan1.title: ニチレイ サイバー攻撃影響などで売り上げ50億円減少の見通し
japan1.description: 冷凍食品大手のニチレイは、サイバー攻撃によるシステム障害で倉庫からの出庫業務が一時停止したことなどによる売り上げの減少が、通期で50億円にのぼるという見通しを明らかにしました。

japan1.title: スーパーのコメ平均価格 5キロ3198円 6週連続で値下がり
japan1.description: 全国のスーパーで今月2日までの1週間に販売されたコメの平均価格は、5キロあたり税込み3198円と、前の週より100円以上、下がりました。値下がりは6週連続で、およそ1年10か月ぶりの水準です。

japan1.title: 秋田市に日本最大級のデータセンター整備計画
japan1.description: AI向けのデータセンターの需要が急速に高まる中、秋田市のIT企業がアメリカの企業と共同で市内に日本で最大級のデータセンターの整備を計画していることがわかりました。会社では整備費について2兆円以上を見込んでいて、UAE＝アラブ首長国連邦の政府系ファンドからの投資の受け入れに向けて協議を進めるとしています。

japan1.title: 公的年金積立金運用実績 四半期として過去最高の黒字 GPIF
japan1.description: 公的年金の積立金を運用しているGPIF＝年金積立金管理運用独立行政法人は、ことし4月から6月までの運用実績が24兆円余りの黒字で、四半期としては過去最高になったと発表しました。

japan1.title: 6月景気動向指数が上昇 景気の基調判断「改善」を維持 内閣府
japan1.description: ことし6月の景気動向指数は、景気の現状を示す「一致指数」が118.2と、前の月を0.3ポイント上回り、内閣府は「改善を示している」という景気の基調判断を維持しました。

japan1.title: 中国 7月の輸出額23％余増加 半導体やEVがけん引
japan1.description: 中国の先月の輸出額は、去年の同じ月と比べて23％余り増えました。半導体やEV＝電気自動車の輸出が増えたことが主な要因で、内需が停滞する中、輸出は好調な状況が続いていて経済を下支えしています。

japan1.title: 株価 小幅に値下がり
japan1.description: 7日の東京株式市場、日経平均株価は小幅に値下がりしました。

japan1.title: 土地取得ルール「届け出必要な対象拡大を」国交省の有識者会議
japan1.description: 不適切な土地の利用による住民とのトラブルなどを防ぐため、国土交通省の有識者会議は土地を取得する際に届け出が必要となる対象を広げるべきなどとする提言をまとめました。

japan1.title: 4月-6月決算ピーク イラン情勢の不透明感後退で上方修正相次ぐ
japan1.description: 上場企業のことし4月から6月の決算発表がピークを迎え、原油の先物価格が一時期より下落していることなどから今年度の業績見通しを上方修正する企業が相次いでいます。

japan1.title: 食料自給率 過去最低 ここにも“米騒動”の影響が【Q＆A】
japan1.description: 7日発表された昨年度のカロリーベースの食料自給率は37％。2020年度などとならんで過去最低の数字です。この落ち込みにも影を落としているのが、おととし以降のコメ価格の高騰だといいます。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz 8月7日(金) 春の原油価格上昇 物価押し上げへ
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 米 半導体や太陽光パネルの材料に追加関税 中国を念頭か
japan1.description: アメリカのトランプ大統領は、半導体や太陽光パネルの主な材料となる「ポリシリコン」やその派生品に追加関税などを課す文書に署名しました。この材料の生産で高いシェアを占める中国を念頭にした措置とみられます。

japan1.title: 6月家計調査 7か月連続で減少 台風や梅雨で幅広く支出が減少
japan1.description: ことし6月に2人以上の世帯が消費に使った金額は、物価の変動を除いた実質で前の年の同じ月と比べて3.3％減少しました。台風や梅雨による天候不順などの影響で、食料や衣料品などさまざまな支出が減りました。

japan1.title: 4月30日の市場介入 6兆円余 円買いとして1日あたりで過去最大
japan1.description: 政府・日銀がことし4月30日に加え、大型連休中の5月4日と6日に市場介入を行ったことが分かりました。

japan1.title: アメリカの原油輸出減少 代替調達進める日本にも影響可能性も
japan1.description: 中東情勢を受けて、日本にとって原油の代替調達先としてアメリカの重要性が増す中、ことし6月のアメリカからの原油の輸出が前の月と比べて減少に転じました。今後もこうした傾向が続けば日本の原油調達に影響が及ぶ可能性もあり、アメリカの輸出動向が注目されます。

japan1.title: 大手企業の夏のボーナス初の100万円超 経団連最終集計
japan1.description: 大手企業のこの夏のボーナスに関する経団連の最終集計がまとまり、従業員1人あたりの平均で104万円余りと、いまの方法で調査を始めた1981年以降で最も高くなり初めて100万円を超えました。

japan1.title: 経産省 日本製紙の煙突倒壊受け自家発事業者に報告求める通知

eu2.title: Anthropic says AI could bring both 15% growth and mass unemployment by 2030
eu2.description: Anthropic has published an economic model projecting how AI might reshape the US economy by 2030, and its three scenarios range from barely perceptible to a boom with no historical precedent, including one in which GDP grows 15% a year while nearly a fifth of office workers are out of a job.

eu2.title: Italy extends diesel excise cut by one week: set to be last general discount
eu2.description: The Italian government has extended the discount on diesel at petrol stations: the 17.1 cent per litre cut will remain in force until 17 September. It is the 15th measure to curb rising fuel prices, with an overall cost of about €2.7 billion.

eu2.title: EU falls short on Draghi reform agenda, new report shows
eu2.description: The European Union is implementing the recommendations of former Italian Prime Minister Mario Draghi, but at a pace that is failing to keep up with the rest of the world.

eu2.title: Formula 1 sends Madrid holiday rents soaring: Up to €20,000 near circuit
eu2.description: The Spanish Grand Prix is driving luxury short-term rents in Madrid up by as much as 1,000%, and in Valdebebas some flats are being listed at up to 20,000 euros for the race.

eu2.title: Will Seat disappear? Government confident as Volkswagen weighs brand's future
eu2.description: The government says it is confident Seat will continue after Volkswagen kept several options open for the brand beyond 2030, adding no decision has yet been made on its future.

eu2.title: Portuguese economist Ricardo Reis dropped by IMF after criticising Trump tariffs
eu2.description: Ricardo Reis warned that tariffs could drive up prices in the United States and potentially trigger a new wave of inflation.

eu2.title: European Commission proposes EU preference in public procurement, excluding Chinese firms
eu2.description: The EU executive has proposed a legislation introducing a European preference in public procurement for strategic public services, a move that clearly targets Chinese companies in a market valued at €2 billion annually.

eu2.title: EU moves to curb Airbnb-style rentals to boost long-term housing
eu2.description: The EU has introduced a framework to support long-term rentals in tourist-heavy cities. Airbnb warns it creates regulatory uncertainty without improving long-term housing outcomes.

eu2.title: Egypt, Greece and Cyprus back plans to bring Cypriot gas to Europe
eu2.description: Cyprus’ Cronos gas is expected to reach European markets via Egypt from 2028, with Greece offering an onward route into southeastern and central Europe. The three countries renewed their backing for the plan at their El Alamein summit.

eu2.title: Google to invest €13bn in Finnish AI data centres, its biggest European push yet
eu2.description: Google will spend at least €13 billion on data centres and digital infrastructure in Finland over the next two years, its largest single investment in Europe, in a bet on the country's cheap power and climate.

eu2.title: Growth nearing 1% of GDP and higher revenues: what it means for the 2027 Budget Law
eu2.description: According to economist Pietro Reichlin, speaking to Euronews, the 1% forecast "is realistic, but Italy remains last in the EU". Growth is not enough to widen the room for the 2027 budget, held back by structural flaws like low productivity and an ageing population.

eu2.title: European Parliament's report tightens EU investment conditions as China negotiations heat up
eu2.description: The European Parliament’s rapporteurs on the proposed Industrial Accelerator Act are closing the EU market to Chinese investment in sectors where Beijing is dominant, going further than what the European Commission suggested.

eu2.title: Exclusive: Italy proposes no fees for digital euro payments under €10
eu2.description: Italy suggests exempting smaller merchant fees for payments under €10, a measure backed by the central banking community, as final talks take place in Brussels over the rollout of the digital euro.

eu2.title: Six months into Hormuz blockade, Qatar and UAE test ways to keep LNG moving
eu2.description: LNG exporters are looking for ways around the disruption in Hormuz, with three Gulf cargoes recently moved using ship-to-ship transfers (STS) as Qatar and UAE exports remain far below pre-war levels.

eu2.title: Sweden to buy Lockheed Martin's HIMARS rocket artillery in €630 million deal
eu2.description: Sweden's government has authorised its armed forces to buy the US-made HIMARS rocket artillery system from Lockheed Martin for around 7 billion Swedish crowns, almost €630 million, and has signed a parallel agreement with Finland to operate the two countries' rocket artillery together.

eu2.title: Jaguar Land Rover cuts 4,000 jobs worldwide in effort to save costs
eu2.description: JLR said it would cut around 4,000 roles worldwide over the next two years as part of its plan to simplify its organisation and generate £1.7 billion (€2bn) in savings.

eu2.title: Mistral AI raises record €3 billion in Samsung-led funding round
eu2.description: French artificial intelligence company Mistral AI has raised €3 billion in a round led by Samsung Electronics, nearly doubling its valuation to more than €21 billion in what the company says is the largest equity fundraising ever completed by a European technology firm.

eu2.title: EU pay transparency: Are job ads finally getting honest about salaries?
eu2.description: Only a few EU countries met the deadline for the Pay Transparency Directive. Indeed’s data shows possible changes in the share of job postings that include salary information.

eu2.title: Record fuel price rise sparks honking protests in Portugal amid public anger
eu2.description: A slow-drive protest and blaring car horns marked the day fuel prices rose again in Portugal, with fuel costs hitting record highs across Europe.

eu2.title: Can tech giants curb AI data centres’ growing thirst for water?
eu2.description: As opposition to water-hungry data centres grows in the US, tech giants say new cooling systems can curb demand – but using less water may require more electricity.

eu2.title: French EDF Energy in talks to buy British So Energy as UK supply market consolidates
eu2.description: France's EDF Energy is reportedly in discussions to buy So Energy, the smaller British supplier whose Irish parent company has put it up for sale, in a deal that would add to a renewed wave of consolidation among UK gas and electricity retailers.

eu2.title: Europe’s busiest ports ranked: Which move the most goods?
eu2.description: Sea shipping keeps Europe fed, fuelled and supplied — and this year, the Iran war's disruptions to shipping routes have thrust it into the headlines. Euronews looked at the busiest ports in Europe by volume of goods transported.

eu2.title: Chainsaw maker STIHL chief calls for longer hours without extra pay
eu2.description: In an opinion piece for Euronews, Dr Nikolas Stihl, chairman of world-leading chainsaw maker STIHL, calls for reforms including a 40-hour working week without extra pay to safeguard Germany's prosperity and welfare state.

eu2.title: Fitch upgrades Portugal to A+, its best credit rating in 15 years
eu2.description: The upgrade reflects years of falling public debt and stronger-than-expected growth in Portugal, Fitch said, restoring a rating not seen since 2011. President Seguro hailed the news, though Fitch cautioned that defence spending and housing costs still pose risks.

eu2.title: STIHL chief: Time for reforms — this is how we retain prosperity and the welfare state
eu2.description: Germany's economy has been in crisis for years, writes Nikolas Stihl in an OpEd for Euronews. Better business conditions are key to breaking the stagnation, he argues — with nothing less than prosperity and the welfare state at stake.

mid1.title: ‘The family paid the price’: India’s deadly online gambling crisis
mid1.description: Debts and deaths are mounting, as a soaring online gambling industry adapts to evade an Indian government ban.

mid1.title: China’s Xi heads to India for BRICS summit overshadowed by wars
mid1.description: Wars in the Middle East and Ukraine, along with global energy security, are expected to dominate the summit.

mid1.title: A stable Afghanistan post 9/11 is in US interests says former US diplomat
mid1.description: Former US diplomat Zalmay Khalilzad says Washington wants to prevent Afghanistan becoming a hub for anti-US groups.

mid1.title: Mexico rescues eight from clandestine clinic run by violent Jalisco cartel
mid1.description: Rescue operation in Jalisco uncovers cartel's hidden clinic, illegal drugs and weapons; six suspected guards arrested.

mid1.title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles off eastern coast, Seoul says
mid1.description: South Korea said it was closely exchanging information on the launches with the US and Japan.

mid1.title: Putin and Pezeshkian call out US dominance ahead of BRICS
mid1.description: The presidents of Iran and Russia have criticised US dollar dominance ahead of the BRICS summit in India.

mid1.title: Satellite image shows critical Saudi pipeline damaged in drone attack
mid1.description: Saudi Arabia has shut its East-West oil pipeline after a drone attack. Riyadh says the attack originated in Iraq.

mid1.title: CIA releases dozens of declassified documents on bin Laden prior to 9/11
mid1.description: A briefer told Clinton in 1998 that bin Laden’s 'preferred option is to strike the US on its own soil in Washington'.

mid1.title: How Canadians are bracing for the impact of Trump’s trade war
mid1.description: Canada’s buy-local movement remains strong, but new tariffs could test how much more shoppers are willing to pay.

mid1.title: Passenger train derails in France, leaving 44 injured, 1 critical
mid1.description: French train derailment sparks emergency response, with 130 firefighters and five medical teams dispatched to the scene.

mid1.title: Former top US diplomat reveals mistakes made after 9/11 attacks
mid1.description: Ambassador Zalmay Khalilzad describes misgivings about the US handling of the Afghanistan and Iraq wars.

mid1.title: Iran war live: Houthis control Red Sea coast, Saudi pipeline shut down
mid1.description: Houthi forces seize Yemen's Red Sea coast while Saudi Arabia suspends crucial oil pipeline following drone attack.

mid1.title: UN extends partial Sudan arms embargo for a month
mid1.description: Sudan’s UN ambassador said a total arms embargo goes against the UN Charter that guarantees a right to self-defence.

mid1.title: Flavio Bolsonaro faces corruption probe weeks before Brazil election
mid1.description: The investigation came to light as Brazil's Supreme Court unseals files related to the Banco Master corruption scandal.

mid1.title: Israeli demolitions threaten schools and homes in Masafer Yatta
mid1.description: Students pledge to continue learning as Masafer Yatta demolitions target homes, schools, and their right to education.

mid1.title: Saudi Arabia says East-West pipeline hit by drones launched from Iraq
mid1.description: Iraq condemns the attack, dismisses a military commander who led operations in Maysan province.

mid1.title: Sabalenka vs Rybakina: US Open women’s singles final – start, prize, form
mid1.description: Top seeds Aryna Sabalenka and Elena Rybakina clash in a Grand Slam final for the second time this year.

mid1.title: Somber tributes as US marks the 25th anniversary of September 11 attacks
mid1.description: Families are remembering the loved ones they lost in the September 11, 2001 attacks on the US.

mid1.title: Zohran Mamdani commemorates 9/11 amid widespread criticism
mid1.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani commemorated the 25th anniversary of 9/11, calling it the “darkest day” in the city's history.

mid1.title: US legislators push AI safety laws amid human extinction warnings
mid1.description: Concerns over AI's dangers grow as US legislators introduce bills to ensure human oversight and prevent rogue systems.

mid1.title: US lawyer cites fake witnesses in murder case, blames ChatGPT
mid1.description: State supreme court fined the attorney and held him in contempt for not verifying facts in a court filing.

mid1.title: Razaullah’s six-hitting debut caps Pakistan’s fightback against England
mid1.description: Pakistan all out with a second innings lead of 130 at the close on day three of the third Test at Edgbaston.

mid1.title: Can BRICS help reshape global order by strengthening emerging economies?
mid1.description: Leaders of BRICS member states are meeting at a summit in New Delhi, India.

mid1.title: Hot pursuit: Man who robbed Indian bank using chilli powder arrested
mid1.description: A man posing as a customer threw chilli powder into the eyes of employees at a bank in Nagpur city, western India.

mid1.title: Declassified documents show UK aware of Israeli war crimes for 24 years
mid1.description: UK Foreign Office files, public since 2024, record warnings about Israeli violence and rights abuses since 2002.

ca3.title: 'Canada is everyone, for everyone': Carney meets with Alberta remain campaigners
ca3.description: The head of the Forever Canadian group campaigning for Alberta to remain in the federation said Friday Prime Minister Mark Carney has been a "calm" and "reassuring" presence for Albertans.

ca3.title: Gander gave Americans a lift on 9/11. 25 years later, it was the other way around
ca3.description: On a day when the compassion of people in Gander, N.L. was being celebrated, a chance encounter at a chicken restaurant led to a tour bus of Americans repaying the favour.

ca3.title: Drone-powered ad for PC Health chatbot slammed as 'dystopian' by some residents
ca3.description: On Thursday night, more than a thousand drones lit up the sky above Toronto's waterfront displaying a list of health-related questions in what turned out to be an ad campaign for a new President's Choice AI-powered chatbot.

ca3.title: Alberta government launches ad campaign on referendum questions
ca3.description: The Alberta government has launched a $4-million advertising campaign outlining its position on the 10 questions in the Oct. 19 referendum.

ca3.title: Why isn't Canada blocking the Welland Canal? Other trade war questions answered
ca3.description: CBC News readers, viewers and listeners have been sending in questions about the trade war, often asking how Canada can turn up the heat on the U.S.

ca3.title: Accused in Edmonton temple attack has history of violence driven by delusions, parole documents show
ca3.description: Federal parole board documents show the 27-year-old man charged in a stabbing inside an Edmonton Sikh temple last month had a history of “serious and impulsive” violence, often driven by delusions, paranoia and conspiracy theories.

ca3.title: Would a $20 minimum wage in Quebec actually be a 'big blow' to the economy?
ca3.description: Québec Solidaire is pitching a $20 minimum wage to help bring relief to low-income workers, but Coalition Avenir Québec Leader Christine Fréchette said hiking the rate too quickly would have a detrimental ripple effect. Others aren't so sure.

ca3.title: Where I was on 9/11: Four people in N.L. share their stories
ca3.description: For many, Sept. 11, 2001, is a day they will never forget, and on the 25th anniversary of the attacks, four Newfoundlanders and Labradorians remember how they helped those in need.

ca3.title: Wildfires, permafrost thaw in Canada causing even more climate change, new study shows
ca3.description: These climate feedback loops, where climate change triggers more greenhouse gas emissions that in turn feed into even more climate change, could add 20 to 30 per cent more warming over current estimates for this century.

ca3.title: As Dean Penney gets life sentence, sister says she's 'lost' without Jennifer Hillier-Penney
ca3.description: It was an emotional day for the family of Jennifer Hillier-Penney, as her estranged husband was given life in prison for killing her in 2016.

ca3.title: First phase of Army restructuring creates division focused on defending Canada
ca3.description: Canada's Army formally made one of the biggest changes to its structure in decades Thursday by shifting from divisions based on geography to ones built around specific purposes. A new division, that prepares the army to rapidly deploy, will be headquartered in Edmonton.

ca3.title: Homelessness on the rise in Ontario while province on track to spend less, report says
ca3.description: Homelessness in Ontario is on the rise, climbing by more than 23 per cent over the past four years to more than 76,000 people, but the province is projected to spend less on it, the fiscal watchdog says in a new report.

ca3.title: Ontario Science Centre lays off 31 workers, union says
ca3.description: The Ontario Science Centre has laid off 31 workers, according to the union representing them. The union said the layoffs eliminated the centre's "standalone science unit."

ca3.title: Cat in the Hat suspect who chased a teen girl in B.C. appears to be a trend copycat
ca3.description: A disturbing incident in which someone dressed in a Cat in the Hat costume chased a teenager in West Kelowna, B.C., occurred amid an online trend that twists the popular children's character into something sinister, leading police in some jurisdictions to warn of offline consequences.

ca3.title: Call for 'fire champion' in each First Nation as Ontario fire marshal investigates fatal Grassy Narrows blaze
ca3.description: The National Indigenous Fire Safety Council is advocating for more fire prevention support as Ontario’s Office of the Fire Marshal and the Treaty Three Police Service investigate a house fire that left three people dead in Asubpeeschoseewagong Netum Anishinabek, also known as Grassy Narrows First Na

ca3.title: Separatists dominating Alberta referendum conversation online: report
ca3.description: Debate about Alberta independence is dominated by a loose network of citizens, advocates and anonymous social media accounts. Some of whom are also selling home decor.

ca3.title: Orange Shirt Day founder says her truth is being 'pushed aside' by controversial shirts
ca3.description: The founder of Orange Shirt Day and MPs say orange shirts with statements printed "Still no proof," and "You can't handle the truth," are "disgusting" and a "disgraceful and grotesque attempt to exploit human suffering for financial gain."

ca3.title: Man, 27, charged in stabbing inside Edmonton Sikh temple
ca3.description: In a news release Thursday, police said Austin Sim-Pelletier, 27, has been charged with two counts of assault causing bodily harm, one count of possession of a weapon for a dangerous purpose, and mischief.

ca3.title: Family of teen struck at Toronto intersection where speed camera was removed sues province, city and driver
ca3.description: The family of a teen struck by a driver at a Toronto intersection that used to have an automated speed enforcement (ASE) camera before Ontario passed legislation to remove it is suing the province, city and driver for millions of dollars in damages.

ca3.title: Doug Ford says he's open to idea of involuntary addiction treatment
ca3.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford said he's open to the idea of involuntary addiction treatment. Ontario's Big City Mayors group recently repeated a request to the province to review existing mental health laws with the idea of expanding involuntary treatment.
